name: Polish Red Dog
description: Banking game: players bet without seeing their cards or the dealer's card that they hold a same-suit card higher than the dealer's upcard; winner is paid twice the bet from the pot. Also Stitch, Polski Pachuck.

overview.description: Banking game: players bet without seeing their cards or the dealer's card that they hold a same-suit card higher than the dealer's upcard; winner is paid twice the bet from the pot. Also Stitch, Polski Pachuck.

history.origins: Polish Red Dog is a variant of the Red Dog banking game family, similar to Slippery Sam but with fully blind betting: players bet without seeing either their own three cards or the dealer's card. It was described in Ostrow's Complete Card Player (1945) and reprinted in various later card-game books; alternative names include Stitch and Polski Pachuck.
timeline: 1945: Described in Ostrow's Complete Card Player (1945); Polish variant of Red Dog. Recorded in Austro-Hungarian region as early as 1836.

setup.players: Two to about eight; one is dealer (banker), others bet in turn.
setup.dealing: Dealer puts up a fixed initial stake. Dealer deals three cards face down to each other player; players do not look at their cards until after betting.

rules.objective: Players bet that they hold a card of the same suit as and higher than the card the dealer will turn up; they do not see their own cards or the dealer's card before betting. Winner is paid twice the bet from the pot; otherwise the bet goes to the pot.
rules.gameplay: Banker puts up a fixed stake. Each player in turn may bet up to half the current pot without seeing their cards or the dealer's card. Dealer burns one card then turns up one card; player's three cards are exposed. If the player has a higher card of the same suit as the dealer's card, the player is paid twice the bet from the pot; otherwise the bet is added to the pot. If the pot is busted, deal passes. When the pot reaches at least three times its initial size, the dealer may declare a stitch round (final deal) and then keep any remainder; deal then passes left.
keyRules: No one sees cards before bet
Burn one then reveal dealer card

scoring.description: Player wins 2× bet if same-suit higher card; else bet to pot. Stitch: when pot ≥ 3× initial, dealer may declare final round and keep remainder.
scoring.winCondition: Player wins twice the bet from pot if hand contains a same-suit card higher than dealer's upcard; otherwise bet is added to pot.

synthesis.shortDescription: Banking game: bet without seeing cards; same-suit higher wins twice the bet. Also Stitch, Polski Pachuck.
